reason: A DeepSeek Harness workflow plugin that encourages investigation before code changes by tracking research and mutation tools, injecting reminders, detecting blocked research, and optionally warning or denying edits.

summaries.zh: 一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的工作流插件，通过跟踪研究与修改工具、注入提醒并检测研究受阻情况，促使智能体在编辑代码前先进行调查。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness workflow plugin that encourages agents to investigate documentation, code, and community sources before editing by tracking tools and injecting reminders.

capabilities: Injects research reminders into agent context and system prompts
Detects failed investigation attempts and repeated failures
Can warn or deny configured mutation-tool calls based on research state
Records plugin-sourced reminders in session logs
